premise: A drizzle comes; Mushroom stretches her cap to make room for Ladybug and Butterfly, and they tell stories until the rain stops.
inspiration: The Mitten (Ukrainian folk tale), turned: the shelter never bursts, it stretches, and the squeeze is the cosy part.
lesson: There is always room for one more friend.

en-US.title: Mushroom's Shelter
en-US.text: {canvas:rain 0.35 40s} {sfx:drizzle} Plip. Plop. A drizzle began. Up popped a little {mushroom:enter} mushroom with a red spotty cap. Along came {ladybug:enter} Ladybug, hurrying on her six little legs. [excited] Can I come in? Of course, said Mushroom {mushroom:face happy} {mushroom:pulse}. Ladybug {ladybug:face happy} {ladybug:hop} scooted under. Then {butterfly:enter} Butterfly fluttered down, {butterfly:face sad} with damp wings. [sad] Is there room for me? The cap was small. [softly] Let's see, said Mushroom, and stretched it {mushroom:glow} as wide as it would go. {butterfly:face happy} Squeeze, squeeze… just right! Butterfly {butterfly:live hold} folded her wings together over her back and rested. Ladybug told a story about the stars. Butterfly told one about the sea. Then Mushroom's nose tickled. {mushroom:live} Ah… ah… ACHOO! Out came a puff of glitter. [giggles] How they {ladybug:wobble} laughed! Nobody noticed the rain stop, until Butterfly {butterfly:live resume} opened her wings wide and fluttered. {ladybug:live} Ladybug lifted her red wing cases, spread her thin wings, folded them away… and bowed. Thank you, Mushroom! {mushroom:hearts}

es-ES.title: El refugio de Seta
es-ES.text: {canvas:rain 0.35 40s} {sfx:drizzle} Plic. Ploc. Empezó a chispear. Brotó una {mushroom:enter} seta pequeñita de sombrero rojo con lunares. Y llegó {ladybug:enter} Mariquita, corriendo con sus seis patitas. [excited] ¿Puedo entrar? Claro que sí, dijo Seta {mushroom:face happy} {mushroom:pulse}. Mariquita {ladybug:face happy} {ladybug:hop} se metió debajo. Luego bajó {butterfly:enter} Mariposa revoloteando, {butterfly:face sad} con las alas mojadas. [sad] ¿Hay sitio para mí? El sombrero era pequeño. [softly] A ver, dijo Seta, y lo estiró {mushroom:glow} todo lo que pudo. {butterfly:face happy} Apretadita, apretadita… ¡justo! Mariposa {butterfly:live hold} juntó las alas sobre la espalda y descansó. Mariquita contó un cuento de estrellas. Mariposa contó uno del mar. Entonces a Seta le picó la nariz. {mushroom:live} Aaa… aaa… ¡ACHÍS! Salió un soplo de purpurina. [giggles] ¡Cómo se {ladybug:wobble} rieron! Nadie se dio cuenta de que ya no llovía, hasta que Mariposa {butterfly:live resume} abrió las alas y revoloteó. {ladybug:live} Mariquita levantó su caparazón rojo, desplegó sus alas finitas, las guardó… e hizo una reverencia. ¡Gracias, Seta! {mushroom:hearts}

drizzle.prompt: a light drizzle pattering softly on a mushroom cap and leaves
